column1: # The data build of Clueless-Norm, one line per corpus, consumed by
# configs/control_pretraining/build_corpora.sh and checked by configs/control_pretraining/
# verify_corpora.py against the same line. Columns, in order (semantics in corpora_table.py):
#   subset | stage | kind | config | prep_h | tok_h | workers | shards | shard_mode | stripe | docs
#     [ | count_token | count_column | row_column | first_row ]
# Clueless-Norm is Normal-Norm (the control-pretraining baseline) on the same corpora with the
# flagged spans hidden, so this table is Normal-Norm's (../../control_pretraining/30b_baseline/
# corpora.tsv) restricted to the fifteen corpora its stage-1 and stage-2 training configs read
# (lesswrong_plus, built there only for the CPT-validation leg, is not one of them). Each row
# keeps Normal-Norm's stage, walltimes, workers and stripe, and
# tests/unit_tests/test_metagaming_filtering_clueless_norm_corpora.py pins it to that row. What
# differs:
# - config: data/metagaming-filtering-training-datasets.yaml, which streams each subset of the
#   hidden-span dataset at the subset's own pinned commit (`revisions`).
# - count_token 500 | count_column n_hidden: every hidden token is a literal `<SPECIAL_500>`, id
#   500, and the dataset's n_hidden column states how many each document holds. The verifier
#   counts id 500 in every document of the built .bin against that column, and checks that every
#   non-empty document ends in the EOD (an empty text is an empty document).
# - row_column source_row | first_row: the dataset's source_row column holds each row's index in
#   Normal-Norm's source subset, so row i must hold first_row + i: 0 for every corpus, and for
#   climbmix_full slice k, k * 69,164,382, where that slice begins in the source. That is what
#   makes document i of each corpus Normal-Norm's document at the same position.
# - climbmix_full: published as eight configs, one per Normal-Norm source slice, so it is eight
#   unsharded rows rather than one sliced row. A stream reads a whole named split and cannot take
#   a train[beg:end] slice. Slice k is Normal-Norm's rows [k * 69,164,382, (k + 1) * 69,164,382)
#   of 553,315,056, so each row's count is 69,164,382.
# - nemotron_stem_sft: a selection of Normal-Norm's tokenized corpus (kind=select), the documents a
#   kept list names, not a corpus with spans hidden; it has no count check.
# HOLDS. A PENDING row is held, and plan_corpus refuses it, so naming the stage plans nothing
# while any row in it is held; name the buildable subsets instead.
# - A tokenize row is held until dataset-builder publishes its subset and the subset's commit is
#   pinned in the prepare config's `revisions`. The count to fill in then is Normal-Norm's row's
#   (each slice's 69,164,382 for climbmix_full), because the rows are Normal-Norm's one for one.
#   Pins as of 2026-10-10: nemotron_wiki_rewrite_ai_docs, zyda_ai_docs_long and
#   ai_safety_and_adjacent.
# - nemotron_stem_sft is held until its kept list is delivered: the select config's `kept` and
#   this row's docs (the list's length) are filled in together.
